query: What do Google Pixel 3 owners report about camera quality, including blurry shots or photos in low light?
search_text: What do owners report about camera quality, including blurry shots or photos in low light?

rows.text: Low light camera. I bought this for my sister and even if it's refurbiahed is a pixel, a great option for that price range and the camera still delivera spectacularly on low light conditions

Amazing photo quality for a SHORT time. Camera stopped working exactly at one year mark when warranty expired, called company and they don’t want to fix it , these phones are known to have camera issues. DO NOT BUY.

Great phone at black Friday prices. The black Friday deal on this phone was great. The camera takes exceptional photos especially at low light and city night shots are stunning. A bit low on memory at 64 gb but unlimited HQ storage on Google photos helps. A small glitch is edited photos and live pictures end up in separate new files each time making it hard to backup those images as the file names always change. Prob should be in one folder called edits.

Camera Blurry. Had hoped to get more than a year out of this phone. Camera focus suddenly looked blury at the 1 year mark. Worked with Google assistance to try several steps, none of which solved the problem. Never again Amazon renewed.

Camera sucks! but there's a fix.. I bought this phone because of all the hype about the camera but it's horrible. The phone itself came in pristine condition but the Pixel camera is trash. Edit: Turns out that google's image processing after you take the shot is the culprit. Look for an app called Camera PX 4.5 Its a fork of google camera that gives you way more control. Play with the tone curves until you're satisfied. Also use night sight even if it's not at night. And disable HDR+

Good for the sale-price, but doesn't compare with leading flagships. This phone's main advantage is the Camera. Here's what you need to know about it: - You have to choose Portrait mode manually for every picture with people in it, it's not automatic like in many other brands. - Image quality can be great, but for me at least it's only great about 50% of the time. The rest of the time, image quality varies greatly, and feels underwhelming mostly. - Panoramic images aren't very well processed (clearly shows the stitching points). - Low light camera is great - when using a tripod. I have yet to find it helpful when photographing people, let alone moving ones. Bottom line I was really disappointed from the so called camera-phone king. This is an OK phone, for a pretty high price.

PIXEL 3 SUCKS - CAMERA DOES NOT LAST - DO NOT BUY THIS PHONE. This phone sucks. The hardware for the camera is awful. I purchased my Pixel 3 phone on October 21 2018. In July 2019 I started experiencing issues with my camera being super blurry and out of focus. I tried all the steps to fix it that Google recommends under the help section. Nothing worked. Luckily my phone was still under warranty and I was able to order a replacement on July 13, 2019. On December 22, 2020 the camera on my replacement phone started experiencing the same issues as before. The camera was very blurry. Thanks to Google I could not take photos during Christmas. My phone is no longer under warranty so I am looking at other manufacturers like the One Plus 7T.

AVOID SELLER TECH EXCHANGE!!!!! Camera does not work pixel 3.. Tech Exchange are selling Google pixel 3's with faulty cameras! There is a common bug with pixel 3 camera with the optical image stabilization where all photos come out blurry. The camera won't focus. Tech Exchange claims all their phones are "rigorously tested" which shows that either they are lying, or they are willingly selling defected phone!

A major disappointment. I bought this phone primarily on the basis of reviews praising its camera. However, I find the camera difficult to operate and, more importantly, the images it takes are of middling quality with low resolution, especially for landscapes and more distant objects and buildings. Don't even think of using the zoom feature--the resulting photos are so grainy that they are basically unusable, which is probably a result of Google's decision to use a digital zoom rather than an optical one. Among other defects are the erratic nature of the finger unlock feature (I now use only the PIN for that purpose) and the difficulty of activating Google Assistant. The setup is not intuitive and reaching the Settings icon is a long ordeal.

Excellent camera!!. Got this for my wife whose only priority is the camera. She was looking specifically for superb low-light photo capability, and this phone is one of the best for that purpose, so she was very happy with it. As for OS updates, it seems to be better than other Android phones, since it is a Google product.

Other than that, my only other semi-minor complaints are: (1) battery life should be better, (2) the side buttons are too hard to push. So much so that I created a volume settings shortcut on my home page and (3) while better than any I've had, the camera still doesn't TAKE photos as fast as an Apple. I still get blur on photos with slow-ish movement; I'm talking aboutn animal moving around, not someone running or driving away.

Missing Features, but great camera. Pros: Camera quality is great and great features on the google photos app. The screen is bright and display quality is amazing. Cons: No timelapse feature in the camera. No wireless charging. No usb c to hdmi to watch movies on the tv. As you can tell my cons are based on features that are missing on the phone.

Camera is defective. So I'm giving this a one star, not for the memory or the battery life, or processing speed or any of that stuff. All that stuff, the phone does fine. But the pixel apparently has an ongoing issue where its camera just doesn't work. And the high quality camera is a huge part of the reason lots of people buy the pixel. This camera issue seems to have been a problem for years and I only found out after actually buying the phone. It's a real shame that a company like Google can't fix or reimburse people for such a massive blunder. I have their camera app a 1 star review. And I'm giving the phone a 1 star until they fix their freaking camera.

Quality photos, lots of memory. I previously had a $150 LG Android, but upgraded to this for the camera. I was not disappointed, it's much better than the one I had before. The extra memory storage is also a plus.

Glitchy with several issues. I chose the Pixel because of its camera - which is amazing. It was a hard decision to switch being that I have had an IPhone for the last 8 years or so. So far, other than the picture quality, I have not been particularly impressed. At times the phone has gotten very hot, and the camera and video become very choppy. Videos taken when this happens are choppy and blurry and audio is distorted and impossible to understand. Additionally, the phone will not connect to the Bluetooth in my car. I have turned the Bluetooth on and off, reset the phone, etc... but nothing. Lastly, the GPS performance has been sub par.
Quality pictures. Good quality pictures. Easy to use because it’s google!
A nice water-resistant camera.. The screen ratio is 18:9, it is good to watch a movie. But compare to Pixel (18:10), it loses a column in the Photo app. Anyhow, the camera is great!
Love the photos. I absolutely love my pixel 3. I bought it for the camara. It takes beautiful pictures and the night sight is amazing.

Almost perfect. Received my phone in great cosmetic condition. Only issue I have is the camera. When moving the phone around even slowly. The autofocus and stabilizer make the image jerk and make the picture look torn. I've reset the camera settings and it still keeps happening. Based on information I've found online it appears the camera module itself is bad on my phone. Not a massive issue, but it does make it hard to take the perfect photo at times. All in all its a great deal but I feel like I got cheated out of a good camera due to the issues I'm having.

DO NOT BUY THIS PHONE - it deletes or loses your photos and you cannot get them back!. I bought this phone because its camera was so highly rated. What I didn't know is that there's some bug where your photos are just deleted/lost/unrecoverable. I just lost every photo I'd taken and after researching online, it's apparently been an uncorrected bug for a long time. Pretty pointless to have a great camera when the operating system deletes the images! It also has extremely poor signal reception compared to my old Droid Maxx phone.
